scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The restored section shows Victor beside the internal passage.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: That is the coat. That is what I saw.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: We have corroboration of his presence now.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: But the picture cannot tell us who opened the way for him.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: No. We compare it with the household access record next.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
